# Writer interoperability fixtures

Original synthetic bilingual content, MIT, generated by the included script
using python-docx, openpyxl and python-pptx. The same inputs were re-exported
headlessly by LibreOfficeDev 26.8.0.0.alpha0 (Writer, Calc, Impress) to DOCX,
XLSX and PPTX. Each fixture is <200 KiB. No Microsoft Office or WPS fixture.
The LibreOffice ZIPs exercise streaming data descriptors.
